acceptanceCriteria: A timed-out SIGINT-interrupted run projects as a timeout interruption (not a user cancel) in the receipt and test-validity, covered by the existing fake-runner test
body: PR #1136 (PWP-V0-030) sends SIGINT first on --timeout; the Playwright report then parses with r.Cancelled=true (pre-existing parse), so the projection says cancelled while the infrastructure reason says timeout. Evidence: TestPWPV0030ExternalTimeoutInterruptsRunnerFirst. Expected: the report is labelled interrupted-by-timeout consistently.
title: JS provider: a runner interrupted by SIGINT on --timeout is reported as cancelled, not as a timed-out interrupted run (residual of PR #1136)
